subject.title: [Telegram] 机器人头像更改后无法同步到 Telegram 客户端

question: Should OpenClaw be allowed to mutate the public Telegram bot profile photo from Web UI assistant-avatar changes, and should that be an explicit user action, an opt-in automatic sync, or not supported?
rationale: This crosses from local OpenClaw identity rendering into external account/profile mutation using a bot token and uploaded media, so automation should not choose the product or security boundary alone.

options.title: Explicit opt-in sync action
options.body: Add a Telegram-plugin-owned sync action or setting that uses setMyProfilePhoto, reports status/errors, and requires live Telegram proof before merge.

options.title: Keep Telegram profile manual
options.body: Document that Web UI avatars are OpenClaw-local identity while Telegram bot profile photos remain managed in Telegram/BotFather.

options.title: Automatic bidirectional sync
options.body: Automatically propagate avatar changes both ways, accepting higher surprise, conflict-resolution, and credential-use risk.

recommendation.title: Explicit opt-in sync action
recommendation.body: Add a Telegram-plugin-owned sync action or setting that uses setMyProfilePhoto, reports status/errors, and requires live Telegram proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans current avatar handling, Telegram plugin boundaries, and security policy, and current history routes the carried-forward surfaces through this contributor.
